seoTitle: Email Drip Sequence Planner: Delays to Send Dates
metaDescription: Map a drip email sequence with delays like 2 days after signup and get exact send dates and weekdays from a start date. Free, runs in your browser.
intro: List your emails with delays and get a dated timeline.
why:
Drip sequences are described in delays, but you schedule them on dates. Converting "3 days after the previous email" into real weekdays shows when a send lands on a weekend.

Each delay can count from signup, the previous email or a named earlier email. Times are in the zone you plan in. Turn on the weekend option to move Saturday and Sunday sends to Monday.
howTo: Choose the start date and send time.
Write one email per line as Name | delay.
Optionally move weekend sends to Monday.
Copy the timeline into your tool.

faq.a: Numbers with h, d or w (hours, days, weeks), and an optional "after signup", "after previous" or "after Name".
Yes, it means days after the previous email.
No. Use the time zone planner for that.
